BiblicalUsage: Shamma is a name that changes hands between two men. One is Shamma the son of Zophah, named among the sons of Asher, and the other is the Shammah of the same spelling who stood with David in the field of lentiles and defended it against the Philistines.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name shared by two men is still two stories, and the Shammah who stood in the lentiles is the one Israel remembers.
